name: offpage-secret

card.name: Mira
card.description: Mira keeps the lighthouse above Port Ellis. Grey eyes, dark hair.

about: A secret kept off the page: the narration doesn't use its words.
ledger: at: Port Ellis › Lighthouse › Lamp room

history.content: I ask about the old logbook.

reply: Mira's hand stills on the page. "Old things get lost," she says.

bad.reply: Mira burned the logbook last winter, and she doesn't regret it.
